class.name: FellowPhysicalAnimation3D
class.brief_description: Physical animation: the skeleton's bones as rigid bodies that follow the animation until something pushes them (FellowEngine).

method.name: apply_hit
method.description: Pushes the body nearest [param position] (world, by its capsule's axis) with [param impulse] (newton-seconds) at that point, and weakens it and its neighbours for a moment (see [member hit_weakening]).

method.name: apply_hit_to_bone
method.description: [method apply_hit] at the body of [param bone].

method.name: build
method.description: Builds the bodies (anew; called by itself at run time when the node is ready). They are put where the animation has their bones, and simulated, at the next pose.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes the bodies and their simulator.

method.name: get_balance_stats
method.description: Milestone 183 (decision 0325), with [member balance]: [code]state[/code], [code]hits[/code], [code]staggers[/code], [code]falls[/code], [code]get_ups[/code], the last hit's [code]capture_offset_m[/code], [code]landed_face[/code], [code]fall_seconds[/code] (from the fall to lying still), the last get-up's [code]get_up_clip[/code], [code]get_up_match_error_m[/code] (the mean distance of its first pose's bones from the bodies', after the fit), [code]get_up_blend_speed_max_m_s[/code] and [code]get_up_seconds[/code], and [code]get_up_clips[/code] (the clips found: [code]{name, face, frames}[/code]).

method.name: get_body_bones
method.description: The bones that have a body, in the bodies' order.

method.name: get_body_errors
method.description: Each body's distance from where the animation has it (metres).

method.name: get_body_targets
method.description: Where the animation has each body (world).

method.name: get_body_weakness
method.description: Each body's weakness from hits (0 to 1).

method.name: get_landed_face
method.description: The face the body last landed on (a [enum Face]).

method.name: get_state
method.description: Where the balance is ([member balance]): standing, staggering, falling, down or getting up.

method.name: get_stats
get_up
method.description: Gets up now from lying (down, or limp after a fall): the motion matcher's database's clip tagged [member get_up_tag] that starts on the face the body lies on and whose first pose fits it best — each turned about the vertical and moved over the ground to fit the bodies (least squares, by mass) — played from the bodies' places, blended over [member get_up_blend]; when it stands the motion matcher is put where the clip ends. Returns [code]false[/code] if it is not lying or there is no such clip. With [member auto_get_up] it is called after [member get_up_delay].

method.name: is_built
method.description: Whether the bodies have been built.

method.name: knock_down
method.description: Knocks the body down the way of [param velocity] (its horizontal part), as fast: the fall [member balance] starts beyond [member fall_threshold].

method.name: reset_bodies
method.description: Puts every body where the animation has its bone, at rest, and makes the joints anew there (after a teleport, say).

members.member: Gets up on its own after lying still [member get_up_delay] seconds ([method get_up]).

Milestone 183 (decision 0325): a hit's capture point decides what follows — where the centre of mass would have to be stood over to stop (its offset from the animation's plus the hit's velocity for the whole body, over [code]sqrt(g / h)[/code]). Under [member step_threshold] the drive takes the hit back where it stands; beyond it the character staggers (the [member motion_matcher_path]'s [method FellowMotionMatcher3D.push] that way, about as far as the capture point); beyond [member fall_threshold] it falls — stiff, the pose it stood in turned about its feet as an inverted pendulum falls, then limp past [member topple_angle]. Lying still, it gets up ([member auto_get_up], [method get_up]) and walks on. The impulse of a hit is spread over the body by mass (the struck part as much more as kicks it 1.5 m/s faster). Off: milestone 166's node.
The bodies' physics layers (when they are built).
The physics layers the bodies meet (when they are built). Not their own: they do not meet one another.
The capture point's offset beyond which a hit makes the body fall (a step's reach).
How long the bodies take from where they lie into the get-up clip's first pose.
How long the body lies still before getting up on its own.

The tag of the motion matcher's database's get-up clips (CMU's subjects 139 and 140: [code]benchmarks/scripts/get_cmu_locomotion.sh[/code]). The node adds it to the motion matcher's [member FellowMotionMatcher3D.tags_excluded] (their still lying frames would match standing still). Each clip is played from a tenth of a second before its first bone moves 5 cm to 0.6 s after its hips reach standing height; the face it starts on is found from its first frame.
How far a hit weakens the struck body (its neighbours half as much a link, two links).
A bone at least this long gets a capsule (when the bodies are built).
The [FellowMotionMatcher3D] animating the skeleton: pushed when the body staggers, stopped while it is down, its database's get-up clips played, and put where a get-up ends.
The share of a body's distance from its bone the drive takes back each physics step, beyond following the animation's motion.
How fast a hit's weakness fades (seconds to halve).
The share of a body's angle from its bone the drive takes back each physics step.
Whether the bodies are simulated and driven. Off, the simulator stops and the animation shows; on again, the bodies start where the animation is.
The capture point's offset beyond which a hit makes the body stagger (about a foot's support).
How hard the bodies are driven: 1, they follow the animation as far as they can; under 0.5, the joints are made cones about the pose at that moment; 0, a ragdoll.
A limp body's cone joint: how far it swings from the pose it went limp in (radians).
How far the body topples stiff (about its feet, driven) before it goes limp.
The bodies' mass together (kilograms; when they are built).
A limp body's cone joint: how far it twists (radians).

signal.name: fell
signal.description: The body began to fall the way of [param direction].

signal.name: got_up
signal.description: The body has got up; the motion matcher animates it again.

signal.name: landed
signal.description: The body lies still after a fall on [param face] (a [enum Face]).

signal.name: staggered
signal.description: A hit made the body stagger the way of [param direction], its capture point [param distance] metres off.

constants.constant: Standing (or walking): the animation as it is.
Staggering: the motion matcher pushed the way of the hit.
